description: Explore, proposing a new H2.6 child: the stem needs a steady adaptation signal, not a gradient on every step. Intermittent stem backward in the 28 px phase, which is the most expensive phase (about 71 steps × ~26 ms ≈ 1.8 s). On the E049 tip, on every second step of the 28 px phase (40–70% of steps), use the group-1-detached 28 px step variant. That variant has no group-1 wgrad/dgrad and no BN/GELU backward on the stem maps, and group-1 params get no Muon/SGD update and no momentum-buffer change on those steps. The variant already existed in E037's commit 6293350. On the other steps, run the usual whitening-detached full step with the group-1 LR as scheduled. Do not rescale the LR: single factor. Group 1 still trains on every step at 20/24 px and from 70% to 75% at 32 px, so it still adapts through the 28→32 switch, which E037/E042 say it needs. Lookahead averages every param. Capture the variant in build with channels_last tensors, with error_on_recompile on. Judge on seeds 13–32 against a same-build E049 baseline, plus seeds 0–2.
